description: PAID ($0.003). Current value of a reference series — e.g. series=policy-rate, vat, minimum-wage. Every value carries its official source citation, effective date, last-confirmed date and staleness flag. Pass api_key if you have one (instant card checkout at /pricing); otherwise the response explains how to pay via x402. Every AE series is free to try. After a 200, bind get_changes (free poll) or register_alert (HMAC push; Register: $0 · Delivery after trial: $0.05) on this series so a later gazette does not silently retire the value.

api_key.description: API key (bypasses x402; metered for invoicing)

series.description: Series id, e.g. policy-rate, vat, minimum-wage

name: get_series

outputSchema.description: Current value of one series with source, effective date, last_confirmed and stale flag

confidence_label.description: Evidence verdict derived from source type, verification age and the stale flag (answers: the weakest series read). Rules at /label-rules

coverage_label.description: How much of the question is covered: ready = complete; partial = held with a disclosed limitation or default; gap = no number served. Rules at /label-rules

error.description: Present on a free refusal or error; no charge

label_basis.description: Inputs and the rule ids that produced the two labels

payment_required.description: true when the call needs payment; how_to_pay explains x402 or card
